author: Sofia R.
text: Tip: The Open Door Free Clinic does walk-in flu shots on Saturdays and they do not ask for insurance.

author: Daniel K.
text: Anyone organizing rides for the Centerville seniors who lose lunches on Dec 15? I can drive Tuesdays and Thursdays.

author: Mei L.
text: The Youth Alliance still has spots in their after-school tutoring. Call before Friday.

author: Rahul P.
text: Reminder: you can give public comment by Zoom at Tuesday’s budget hearing. Takes 2 minutes to sign up.

author: Aisha B.
text: Job Seekers Connect Lab is open until 8 pm. Great backup when the library closes early.
